They are drowning inside their own tent. Look at this. Night time. A family in Gaza, sitting in flood water up to their chests. A father holding the tent pole so it doesn't collapse. A mother holding her baby above the water. Little children shivering, crying, trying to keep their heads up. This is not a river. This is not a lake. This is their HOME. Their tent. And look at the next clip — children standing in the mud, soaking wet, clothes covered in dirt, crying because they are cold and there is nowhere dry to go. A mother sitting in the water, covering her face with her hands, broken. She has nothing left to sweep, nothing left to save. Her whole life is under water. A little toddler standing alone in the flood, looking at the camera, not even crying anymore. Just... lost. And the whole camp — thousands of tents — drowning in the storm. The nasheed says: "Have you not seen the orphans and the pure women? And the displaced who left their homes? To Your mercy, O Khalid, open a door for us. Open the door, O Lord." Ya Allah, open a door for them. Have mercy on them. They have no one but You. Please don't let this video pass like nothing. Share it. Make dua for them.
